;;
“七连败为什么不找找自己问题？”
“你买不起房也找找自己问题好不好？”
“你大学毕业找不到工作找找自己问题好不好？”
“特么的什么都找自己问题，nmd我队友炸了我找自己问题？”
“什么？0-3为什么评分比我高？”
“特么的你爸出去赚钱，你妈在家全职家庭主妇，完了月底一结，哎呦你爸mvp！完了你妈全职主妇，不是洗衣就是做饭，躺赢狗！”
“你妈就是躺赢狗！你妈这个月的评分是——3.0！”
“能这样算吗？我问你能这样算吗？”
“……”
和队友狂喷了半个多小时后，云阳愤怒的将耳机摁在桌子上。
“呦，阳哥喷完了？”
“艹！别说了。”听见舍友的话，云阳无语的把电脑关上，“又特么碰上沙币了。”
“唉，团队竞技类游戏就是这样。”躺在上铺的云阳的另一个舍友探出头来，“阳哥，咱要不还是玩单机吧。”
“可以。”云阳点了点头，“已经删游戏准备转战单机了。”
“行了哥们们，游戏的话题要不咱们明天再聊吧，都快十点了，咱要不先上床睡觉吧。”
“ok。”
“行，没问题。”
这算是云阳宿舍的习惯，差不多晚上十点的时候就关灯了。
因为有舍友睡觉比较早，所以大家便约定在十点钟关灯，这样，睡得早的就直接关灯睡觉就行了，睡得晚的就在床上刷会手机再睡呗。

显然，云阳就属于“睡的晚”的那一批人。
躺在床上，云阳打开手机，打算先刷视频刷到12点再说。
只要在十二点之前睡觉，那就不算是熬夜！
摆烂大学生的生活就是这样的，除了享乐外再无其他，生活枯燥且乏味。
先逛某站再看某音，前者看整活，后者看擦边。
不过就在云阳转换网站时却发现，自己手机上不知何时竟多了个软件。
【文字修仙游戏】
嗯？自己什么时候下过这个软件？
不会是什么沟槽的病毒吧？
自己手机什么时候中病毒了？
难道是上次炉时打开某网站的时候？
emmm……好像不小心把自己的某些隐私说出来了。
管他呢，先删了再说。
想到这，云阳立即长摁软件然后点击删除选项。
我点，我点！
嗯？怎么删不了？
卧槽！哥们你真是病毒啊！
当即，云阳尝试了诸如杀毒软件，手机管家以及关机重启等数种方法，但都无济于事。
就差重装系统了。
content_en:
;;
"Why don't you look for your own problems after losing seven games in a row?"
"If you can't afford a house, why don't you look for your own problems?"
"If you can't find a job after college, how about you look for your own problems?"
"You blame yourself for everything. Nmd my teammates blew up and I blame myself?"
"What? Why is 0-3 rated higher than me?"
"What the hell, your dad goes out to make money, and your mom stays at home as a full-time housewife. Once the end of the month is over, your dad is MVP! When your mom is finished, she is a full-time housewife, either doing laundry or cooking. You'll win by lying down!"
"Your mother is a winner! Your mother's rating this month is - 3.0!"
"Can it be calculated like this? I ask you, can it be calculated like this?"
"..."
After arguing with his teammates for more than half an hour, Yunyang angrily pressed his headphones on the table.
"Hey, Brother Yang has finished squirting?"
"Fuck! Stop talking." Hearing his roommate's words, Yunyang shut down the computer speechlessly, "It's a sand dollar again."
"Well, that's how team competition games are." Yunyang's other roommate, who was lying on the upper bunk, poked his head out and said, "Brother Yang, why don't we just play solo."
"Okay." Yunyang nodded, "I have deleted the game and prepared to switch to single-player."
"Okay, guys, why don't we talk about the game tomorrow? It's almost ten o'clock, why don't we go to bed first."
"ok."
"Okay, no problem."
This is the habit of the Yunyang dormitory. The lights are turned off at almost ten o'clock in the evening.
Because some roommates go to bed early, we all agreed to turn off the lights at ten o'clock. In this way, those who go to bed early can just turn off the lights and go to sleep, and those who go to bed late can check their mobile phones in bed before going to sleep.
Obviously, Yunyang belongs to the group of people who "sleep late".
Lying on the bed, Yunyang turned on his phone, planning to watch videos until 12 o'clock.
As long as you go to bed before twelve o'clock, it doesn't count as staying up late!
The life of a college student is like this. There is nothing but pleasure. Life is boring and boring.
Visit a certain station first and then watch a certain sound. The former will read the whole thing, while the latter will read the side effects.
However, when Yunyang changed the website, he discovered that there was an extra software on his mobile phone.
【Text Cultivation Game】
Huh? When did you download this software?
Isn't it some groove virus?
When did your phone get a virus?
Could it be when you opened a certain website during the last fire?
emmm...it seems like I accidentally revealed some of my private parts.
No matter what, delete it first and then talk about it.
Thinking of this, Yunyang immediately pressed and held the software and clicked the delete option.
I order, I order!
Um? Why can't it be deleted?
Damn it! Dude, you are such a virus!
Immediately, Yunyang tried several methods such as anti-virus software, mobile phone manager and shutting down and restarting, but to no avail.
Just need to reinstall the system.
